description: Canonical location of the Gamma PPTX/PDF for a presentation version. JJ-30 rasterises the PDF found here. Do not invent a second path.
lookup_rule: When generation_id is unknown, the newest matching *.{format} under the directory wins.
notes: BT-28 persists artifacts here and associates them with the presentation version.
JJ-30 owns preview rasterisation of the Gamma PDF. BT-28 does not rasterise.
Downloads resolve this location through the existing ready-screen deck URLs.
